entities.summary: Christopher Tyler Austin is an American professional baseball first baseman and outfielder for the Chicago Cubs of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the New York Yankees, Minnesota Twins, San Francisco Giants, and Milwaukee Brewers, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yokohama DeNA BayStars.
